Frank talks for 5 hours per month at the night rate. What would each plan cost him per month? Show your work.

Cost Per Month for Plan A: ____________ zeds

Cost Per Month for Plan B: ____________ zeds

descriptors: Plan A= 140 zeds and Plan B = 375 zeds, with work shown.
140 zeds and 375 zeds with no work shown.
Plan A or plan B correct with work shown but not both.
Incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task).
